title: Monopearl
description: Allows one active pearl per player on a server.
body:
![Monopearl](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3431795e5cd6d8980ee14a2190d88949298f0b9.png)

Monopearl is a simple Minecraft mod for PvP servers that limits each player to one active ender pearl at a time. This prevents pearl-chaining or pearl spamming in fights and it forces players to weigh the costs of a stasis chamber. Stasis chambers can still be used, but they fill the player's pearl cap and prevent them from using ender pearls elsewhere in the world.

# Configuration
The mod can be configured in the `monopearl.json` file.

**The maximum amount of active pearls allowed per player**

`"maxPearlCount": 1`

**Pearls that have been active for more than this number of ticks will not count towards the cap**

`"pearlStaleAge": 214783647`
